app/simulation/persona_agent.py.purpose: Defines 8 persona types with behavioral profiles. Generates UserProfile-compatible objects.
risks: Gig worker same UserType as salaried
findings: income_range sampling biased toward lower end

app/simulation/fraud_campaign_agent.py.purpose: Generates 6 fraud campaign types: ATO, card_testing, money_mule, velocity, synthetic_identity, cross_border.

app/simulation/fraud_ring_agent.py.purpose: Generates 5 fraud ring types with NetworkX graph structures.

app/simulation/adversarial_agent.py.purpose: Applies 8 evasion mutation types to fraud transactions. Computes attack_difficulty 0-100.

app/simulation/fraud_evolution_agent.py.purpose: 4-generation fraud evolution tracker. Applies cumulative mutations per generation.
findings: CRITICAL: no deep evolution beyond gen 4

app/pipeline/fraud_pipeline.py.purpose: LangGraph pipeline orchestrating full fraud detection from feature retrieval to final decision.

app/services/consensus_engine.py.purpose: Aggregates 5 agent risk scores into blended risk_score, agreement_score, confidence_score.
risks: Default score=50 when agent missing (anchoring bias)

app/services/fast_screening.py.purpose: Stage 1 fast screening with 7 components. Routes to deep investigation or auto-approve.
risks: Device novelty score varies by user profile settings
micro_txn rule fires at <50 INR (card testing partial detection)
findings: Latency target <20ms achievable (no I/O in function itself)

app/services/graph_intelligence.py.purpose: In-memory NetworkX undirected graph for fraud ring detection.
risks: Graph is undirected (ring generators use directed)
Mule pattern check very specific (single formula)
findings: CRITICAL: graph type mismatch with ring generators

app/main.py.purpose: FastAPI app with 30+ endpoints covering detection, simulation, feedback, metrics.
risks: /metrics/evaluation uses expected_label as detection = always 100% accuracy
